question: Neeraj Chopra, Clinched the historic gold at Tokyo Olympics 2020 with a throw of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**87.58 m**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neeraj Chopra **clinched the historic gold at** Tokyo Olympics 2020 with a throw of 87.58 m**.
 
• Neeraj Chopra is an Indian track and field athlete who competes in the javelin throw event.
 
• He has won several medals at international events and is considered one of the brightest prospects in Indian athletics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian track and field athlete Neeraj Chopra** is the current world and Olympic champion in the men's javelin throw.

 
• He is the first Asian athlete to win gold in the javelin at the Olympics and the first to win gold in his respective event at the World Championship.
 
• Chopra is the first track and field athlete from India to win an Olympic gold medal.
 
• He is a Junior Commissioned Officer Subedar (JCO) in the Indian Army.
